_comment: Phase 3.3 explicit per-tenant production authorization allowlist. Every operation that targets click-360 (migration, repair, admin flag/seat changes, activation, rollback) must find its exact ownerUid+businessId pair here first, IN ADDITION TO its own --confirm string -- this is a second, independent gate so a single mistaken --confirm can never touch an unauthorized tenant, and a batch/loop can never silently reach production (there is no wildcard entry format). Adding an entry is a deliberate, reviewed, committed code change -- not a CLI flag -- made only after a human (Mr. Smith) has explicitly selected and approved that specific customer for the pilot. This file starts empty and MUST stay empty until that approval happens.

click-360.notes: Canary tenant for Workers rollout: 'Industrias Omega' (legacy business id biz_main). This account also runs a second, separate business ('Industrias Alfa', biz_e4dd1eac-a501-4c25-8ae4-dd7f3bf50eb8) that is NOT authorized and must not be touched. Selected for its low footprint (1 product, 4 sales) and healthy P0 identity. Initial preflight was NO-GO (bad stock data, fixed in the qty->stock migration normalization fix); ACTIVATED 2026-08-22T19:24Z after the fix, businessUnit CUTOVER_VERIFIED, Workers flag ON, structural smoke PASS.

Second tenant for Workers rollout: 'SHARY' (ropa). Named explicitly by the owner in-conversation. Highest real activity of the 5 production tenants (430 products, 18 sales), no existing workers, healthy P0 identity. First migration attempt reached VERIFIED but promotion twice hit 'state/main changed' (genuine concurrent live edits, products grew 419->424 mid-migration) and went stale. Abandoned via scripts/worker-boundary-abandon-stale-attempt.mjs (634 documents backed up to adminBackups, then cleared -- state/main and featureFlags/workers untouched) after confirming state/main hash-stable for ~90s at 01:35 America/Guayaquil. Fresh migrate->promote->flag-on cycle ACTIVATED 2026-08-23T06:41Z, businessUnit CUTOVER_VERIFIED, Workers flag ON, structural smoke PASS. SHARY_WORKERS_ROLLOUT_5_OF_5_COMPLETE.

Flagged as higher complexity (restaurant type + pre-existing workers) but included per the owner's explicit GO/NO-GO batch instruction.
